primary_pair_selection: earliest numeric Zebris replicate_index among conservative_pair_eligible pairs, then anonymous trial id
extension_selection: earliest exploratory-eligible backward replicate_index >= 2 per participant
window_placement: centered in common motion-pressure interval for paired trials; centered in pressure event coverage for extension trials
motion_side_aggregation: arithmetic mean of left and right percentile excursions
pressure_side_aggregation: arithmetic mean of left and right event medians
cross_validation: leave-one-participant-out; all duplicate bootstrap copies of held-out participant excluded from training
coefficient_intervals: HC3 Student t with residual df
equivalence: no substantive threshold asserted; report 90% CI containment frontier and actual observations separately
case_selection: descending standardized Euclidean distance in height, weight and morphology exposure among speed-matched pairs; greedy disjoint participant pairs; tie by anonymous ids; never select by outcomes or strategies
notes: Earlier aggregate QC, repeatability and speed-contact plots have been seen. New body-motion-pressure associations have not. This local freeze is not external preregistration. No anatomical pressure regions are used in v1.
standardized_feature_boundary: Input is a typed, already extracted bundle; no raw device decoding, synchronization, or source-QC reconstruction.
